spec.description: Sisalation® Multipurpose EHD (456) is an extra heavy duty, non-vapour permeable single sided reflective aluminium foil and polyweave laminate with an antiglare face designed to minimize glare during installation.
install: Inspect for damage prior to installation
Repair any tears with appropriate tape
Avoid contact with alkaline products, cement, mortar, and corrosive environments
limitations: Not suitable as an exposed internal wall and ceiling lining where a group number is required
Not suitable for applications where the cladding manufacturer specifies a vapour permeable membrane
Not suitable where a pliable building membrane or sarking-type material is required in climate zones 4–8
Not suitable as a substitute for safety mesh or a fall-arrest system
Not suitable for use within 500m of a saltwater body in unenclosed, ventilated space
Additional mechanical fasteners may be required for product exposed to adverse weather conditions
Not designed to withstand prolonged weathering – exterior cladding should be installed within 8 weeks in a wall application, or 2 weeks in a roof application

source_excerpt:
Sisalation® Multipurpose EHD (456) 
Description
Sisalation® Multipurpose EHD (456) is an extra heavy duty, 
non-vapour permeable single sided reflective aluminium 
foil and polyweave laminate. This product has an antiglare 
face designed to minimise glare experienced during 
installation.
Application
Sisalation® Multipurpose EHD (456) is class 1 vapour 
barrier and water barrier for use in applications such as 
residential and commercial walls, tile roofs (with the exception of slate) and residential and commercial metal roofs, 
subject to the product limitations outlined below. 
Features and benefits
Extra Heavy Duty product Suitable for use in both residential and commercial projects.
Vapour and water barrier Class 1 Vapour barrier and Water barrier.
Anti-glare face Reduces glare during installation.
